in_marathi.name: Subodh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subodh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'subh' (auspicious) and 'odh' (bright), meaning 'bright, wise'. Subodh is a name that signifies intelligence, knowledge, and wisdom. It is a name that is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
